The variant supplies the default semantic element as well as styling. Use as when you need to choose the element separately. Use text for plain text or default for child content.

## Usage

```ts
import { typography } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/typography';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/typography`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="shadcn-typography"></a>

### `shadcn.Typography`

This is a JSON composition.

| Input | JSON type | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "p" \| "blockquote" \| "code" \| "lead" \| "large" \| "small" \| "muted"` | Default `"p"` |
| `as` | `"h1" \| "h2" \| "h3" \| "h4" \| "h5" \| "h6" \| "p" \| "blockquote" \| "code" \| "span" \| "small" \| "strong" \| "em" \| "div"` |  |
| `text` | `string` |  |

Slots `default`.

No events.

#### Example View

```json
{
  "render": {
    "id": "example",
    "componentRef": "shadcn.Typography",
    "inputs": {
      "as": "h2",
      "variant": "h3",
      "text": "Weekly summary"
    }
  }
}
```
